audit.cause: The PTL training builder created a 3-channel patch projection. The first-forward adapter replaced it with a 4-channel module after optimizer parameter groups had been constructed, so the new depth parameter was absent from the optimizer.
audit.evidence: The corrected construction smoke test shows the 3-channel projection before the guard, a 4-channel trainable projection after the guard, and the same parameter object after a 4-channel forward. The corrected run's first checkpoint has nonzero depth weights.

action: Retained as a reproducibility audit only; not used for tables, bootstrap, publication claims, or model selection. Repeated from the generic RF-DETR pretrain after adding the pre-optimizer stem guard.
